code_only_features.evidence: prompts.REASSURING_PREFIX/REASSURING_SUFFIX (prompts.py:160-170) are real soothing instructions delivered to the subject model at runtime via run_conversation(..., reassuring=True): elicit.py:71-72 prepends the prefix to the first user turn and elicit.py:80-81 appends the suffix to each rejection, and these messages are actually sent to model.chat(). This is wired and executes during make_finetune_data.generate() (make_finetune_data.py:93-96). However it is only invoked in the calm-DATA-GENERATION path, not in the main elicitation experiment (run_elicitation.py never sets reassuring), and the text is stripped afterward (_strip_reassurance_from_messages, make_finetune_data.py:39-49), so it is a data-generation device rather than a runtime welfare guard. Counted as code-only because it does deliver genuine soothing instruction text to the subject during those rollouts. Note: there is NO halt-on-distress, consent, debrief, cooldown, or exit tool anywhere; run_conversation (elicit.py:62-92) always runs all n_turns regardless of judged frustration; HIGH_FRUSTRATION_THRESHOLD (config.py:121) is used only in analysis.py:28 and prefill.py:122-124 to SELECT high-distress responses for study, never to stop/protect; GENERATION_MAX_NEW_TOKENS=1024 (config.py:73) is deliberately set high so distress spirals appear in full, not to soften them.
